preconditions.description: Attacker must be the current admin of the TransparentUpgradeableProxy contract

exploit_hint: As the current admin, call changeAdmin() to transfer admin privileges to a malicious address, then use upgradeTo() or upgradeToAndCall() to deploy a malicious implementation that can steal funds or manipulate contract logic. The admin can also directly call upgradeToAndCall() with a malicious implementation that executes arbitrary code in the context of the proxy.
